title: Valve says Steam Machine, its new living room-friendly PC, will start at $1,049 for the 512GB base model, and go on sale starting June 29 (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Valve says Steam Machine, its new living room-friendly PC, will start at $1,049 for the 512GB base model, and go on sale starting June 29 — You can register your interest starting today, and the first emails letting people buy one will go out on June 29th.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Valve's Steam Machine, its new living room Linux PC, will start at $1,049 for the 512GB base model without a controller, and will go on sale starting June 29   —  You can register your interest starting today, and the first emails letting people buy one will go out on June 29th.
